items.title: 20 Sep 2026 (10 days away): Lunar occultation of Sigma Sagittarii
items.summary: The Moon will pass in front of Sigma Sagittarii (Nunki), creating a lunar occultation visible from French Polynesia, New Zealand and Pitcairn.
